govdocs-archive_org-ifePhilipTheNazisBig: Philip Rife’s The Nazis’ Big Apple A-Bomb argues the Nazis planned an atomic attack on New York. The fringe history belongs to alternative WWII literature. Historians find no supporting evidence. The Nazi atomic program lagged badly. The book should be read critically.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-altar-tomb: This 1913 reference article on the altar tomb — the chest tomb of the old churches. Augustin Schulte describes its monument form. Knights and bishops sleep in stone. Their effigies pray forever. The church's marble memory. Their brasses shine in the old naves.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-baron-ferdina: A 1913 entry on Ferdinand de Géramb — the Trappist baron. Edmond Obrecht tells his romantic tale. He left the world for La Trappe. The cloister tamed the soldier. A nobleman turned monk. His Pilgrimage charmed the readers. His habit was the Trappist white.
